package storage

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	sq "github.com/Masterminds/squirrel"
	"github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes"
	flipt "github.com/markphelps/flipt/rpc"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func createEvaluatorFlag(t *testing.T, suffix string, enabled bool) string {
	t.Helper()
	key := t.Name() + "/" + suffix
	_, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(context.Background(), &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{
		Key: key, Name: key, Enabled: enabled,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return key
}

func createEvaluatorRule(t *testing.T, flagKey, suffix string, rank int32) (*flipt.Rule, *flipt.Segment) {
	t.Helper()
	key := flagKey + "/" + suffix
	segment, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(context.Background(), &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{
		Key: key, Name: key,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	rule, err := ruleStore.CreateRule(context.Background(), &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{
		FlagKey: flagKey, SegmentKey: segment.Key, Rank: rank,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return rule, segment
}

func createEvaluatorConstraint(t *testing.T, segmentKey string, typ flipt.ComparisonType, property, operator, value string) *flipt.Constraint {
	t.Helper()
	c, err := segmentStore.CreateConstraint(context.Background(), &flipt.CreateConstraintRequest{
		SegmentKey: segmentKey, Type: typ, Property: property, Operator: operator, Value: value,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return c
}

func TestEvaluatorStorageFlagErrorsAndResponse(t *testing.T) {
	evaluator := evaluatorStore
	ctx := context.Background()

	_, err := evaluator.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: t.Name() + "/missing", EntityId: "entity"})
	require.IsType(t, ErrNotFound(""), err)
	assert.EqualError(t, err, fmt.Sprintf("flag %q not found", t.Name()+"/missing"))

	disabledKey := createEvaluatorFlag(t, "disabled", false)
	_, err = evaluator.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: disabledKey, EntityId: "entity"})
	require.IsType(t, ErrInvalid(""), err)
	assert.EqualError(t, err, fmt.Sprintf("flag %q is disabled", disabledKey))

	flagKey := createEvaluatorFlag(t, "enabled", true)
	requestContext := map[string]string{"region": "us", "tier": "gold"}
